caption: The drawing shows an architectural structure featuring an arched doorway framed by two columns, with a triangular pediment resting above. The columns are pink with a mottled pattern and topped with yellow-gold bases that have volute designs. The arch itself is plain and rendered in a soft gray. Blue rectangular bases support the columns, and there are blue decorative bands running parallel to the pediment’s bottom edge. The pediment is decorated with a repeating pattern of yellow and orange leaves on a blue background, and at the center of the pediment is a circular emblem with a stylized orange flower and green leaves. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with some light shading, and the overall style is watercolor with soft, diffuse edges. In the lower right corner, the name "Edward T. Jewett" is written.
title: Wall Painting
